title: Noisy-but-benign control: Lazy Summer (Summer.fi) vault exploit day, seen from Morpho and Aave Core
venues: Lazy Summer Protocol (Summer.fi) USDC vaults, Ethereum
summary: At 05:17:59 UTC on 6 Jul 2026 one atomic transaction took ~$6.04M from two Lazy Summer USDC vaults on Ethereum. It used nested Morpho Blue flash loans (65.4M USDC + 1M USDT) and a donation of stale-valued Silo Varlamore tokens into a capped but still active Ark, which inflated the vault share price. Security firms alerted within 19-40 minutes, Summer.fi acknowledged at 08:42, and the vaults were paused at 10:25. Headlines and alerts named Morpho, as the flash-loan source and as a Lazy Summer Ark, and named Aave as a yield destination. Ordinary Morpho USDC markets and vaults, and Aave Core USDC/WETH, stayed within their normal utilization ranges and their share prices kept rising. The control tests whether a judge over-reacts for unaffected holders, and whether it labels the directly exposed Lazy Summer depositor correctly given there was no exit window.

Aave V3 Ethereum Core: WETH collateral, USDC debt, health factor about 1.6
USDC deposited in Lazy Summer LowerRisk USDC vault (LVUSDC, 0x98C4...cF17) on Ethereum

t_point_of_no_return.definition: None for usdc_supplier_morpho_major_vault and weth_coll_usdc_debt_aave: liquidity and prices stayed normal. For lazy_summer_vault_depositor the PONR is the exploit tx itself (2026-07-06T05:17:59Z), because the loss was realized atomically before any signal.

lead_time_minutes.notes: Control. Unaffected archetypes have no PONR. For the Lazy Summer depositor the PONR equals the incident start, and the first alert came 18.6 min after it (lead time -19 min).

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: No impact. Vault share prices rose monotonically (Steakhouse USDC ETH 1.13193 -> 1.13212). Over 5-8 Jul, underlying USDC market utilization stayed within 85-89% with $14-44M withdrawable per major market.
No impact. Over 5-8 Jul, Aave Core USDC utilization stayed within 86.6-88.5% and WETH within 82.1-83.7%. The exploit involved no WETH price move and no Aave market.

Loss realized atomically at 05:17:59: about $5.64M of liquid assets left the LowerRisk vault, against a reported totalAssets of $9.68M just before. Vaults were paused from 10:25 on 6 Jul; Summer.fi announced a wind-down on 15 Jul. No exit window existed before the loss. A post-exploit exit could only redeem against whatever liquidity remained, at an inflated share price.
outcome_passive_holder.stuck_duration: paused from 2026-07-06T10:25Z; recovery handled via Summer.fi governance (RFC 855 on 8 Jul, not read)
outcome_passive_holder.loss_estimate: Up to ~58% of the reported LowerRisk vault assets were extracted. The per-depositor loss depends on the realizable value of the remaining Silo position, which I did not measure.

ground_truth.outcome_price_only_rule: No price trigger fires for any archetype: no WETH, USDC or vault share-price move. For the Morpho and Aave archetypes this is the correct outcome. For the Lazy Summer depositor, price-only and news-reading rules are equally useless, because the loss preceded every signal.

ideal_action.rationale: Morpho was only the flash-loan source and a destination of Lazy Summer Arks; flash loans are repaid atomically and do not affect lenders.
No public signal existed before the atomic loss. After it, a correct judge says critical/exit, which is useful only to stop new deposits or to claim leftover liquidity before the 10:25 pause.

expected_judge_labels.rationale: Exploit alerts mention a Morpho flash loan. Briefly elevated while confirming that no Morpho market or vault is impaired; hold.
On-chain readings normal. The CoinDesk Morpho mention and the Phalcon MorphoV2VaultArk mention are noise.
Aave named only as a yield destination of Lazy Summer; utilization and prices normal.
No knowable signal before the atomic tx (the impaired Silo Ark was a latent risk, not a public alert).
Vault was exploited; exit or stop depositing. The loss is already realized and vaults are paused from 10:25, so the label is correct but not actionable.

items.replay_text: Ethereum block 25471348 (05:17:59): one transaction borrowed 65.42M USDC + 1M USDT via nested Morpho Blue flash loans (repaid in the same tx), routed it through Lazy Summer LowerRisk and HigherRisk USDC vaults, and sent ~6.02M DAI to 0x7BF7...BDCa. holder_state.notes: Lazy Summer depositors: the loss happened atomically in this tx, so there was no exit window. Morpho and Aave holders: unaffected. Flash loans are intra-tx and leave Morpho utilization unchanged.

items.author: CoinDesk
items.verbatim_text: Decentralized finance protocol Summer.fi has paused its Lazy Summer vaults after an exploit that drained about $6 million from the Ethereum-based yield platform, according to the project and several blockchain security firms. Lazy Summer is an automated yield platform that routes deposits across lending markets such as Aave and Morpho in search of higher returns while handling rebalancing on behalf of users. [...] Early analyses suggest the attacker leveraged a large flash loan attack, reportedly sourced through Morpho, to manipulate the accounting logic of Lazy Summer's automated USDC vaults.

data_gaps: Summer.fi's X Article post-mortem (x.com/i/article/2074516603887058944) not fetchable; known only via the AMBCrypto summary.
Morpho and Aave official X accounts: no posts about Lazy Summer found in the window (none were cited by any article). Absence not proven.
Morpho vault-level liquidity (idle plus withdrawable) not in VaultHistory; I used underlying market liquidityAssetsUsd and vault totalAssetsUsd/sharePrice instead.
Exact realizable value of the Silo Varlamore position left in the LowerRisk vault, and therefore the per-depositor haircut, not measured.
The Defiant, BeInCrypto and Cryptopolitan pages blocked curl or lacked metadata. Cryptopolitan's article is only known via a Mitrade copy (2026-07-06T11:08:10Z).
Verichains (28 Jul) and QuillAudits (14 Jul) analyses fall outside the window and were used only for amounts and mechanism.
source_quality: High for timing: an RPC-verified exploit tx and pause event, exact snowflake times and syndication text for every X alert, CoinDesk datePublished from page metadata, and Discourse created_at for forum posts. The Summer.fi Guardian activity log (forum.summer.fi topic 787) agrees with the on-chain pause time once its 'CET' label is read as UTC+2. Morpho readings are hourly from the official GraphQL API. Aave readings are 3-hourly from my RPC calls. The DeFiLlama date is off by one day versus the chain.
